[!dolt] skip
# Test bd comments add/list flows
bd init --prefix test --quiet
bd create 'Issue for comments' --description 'Discuss this work item' --json
extractid ISSUE

bd comments add $ISSUE 'This is a test comment' --author alice
stdout 'Comment added'

bd comments add $ISSUE 'Second comment'
stdout 'Comment added'

bd comments $ISSUE
stdout 'This is a test comment'
stdout 'Second comment'
stdout 'alice'

! bd comments nonexistent-id
stderr 'not found|no issue found|Error'
